rules.rationale: The A13 initialization created the standalone android_x86_64 product. Android 16 retains the current AndroidProducts.mk, BoardConfig.mk and android_x86_64.mk definitions; obsolete local Android.bp/license files are no longer required by the current device layout.
rules.necessity: Required because Windows App Player builds and regression use android_x86_64 rather than a unified remote/local board.
rules.performance: Product-definition-only change; selected board flags determine the final image but add no runtime code.
rules.security: Board configuration controls partitions, architecture and security features and must remain bound to the target tree identity gate.
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng lunch and multiple target module builds succeeded from Android-16; the product resolves to TARGET_PRODUCT=android_x86_64 and x86_64/x86 architectures.

rules.rationale: A13 removed old Cuttlefish-only APEX definitions to reduce its build surface. Android 16 upstream has newer Cuttlefish APEX files, but the android_x86_64 product neither references nor installs any com.google.cf module. Deleting current unrelated board support would increase mainline divergence without changing the App Player image.
rules.necessity: Not necessary for the selected android_x86_64 board.
rules.performance: The files are parsed as source metadata but no Cuttlefish APEX is built or installed for the target product; removal would not improve guest boot time.
rules.security: Keeping unused upstream board definitions has no target image exposure and avoids silently weakening Cuttlefish configurations used by other developers.
validation_evidence: Android-16 x86_64 installed-files outputs contain no com.google.cf entry and device/generic/x86_64 plus device/generic/common contain no reference to the reviewed Cuttlefish APEX modules.

rules.rationale: All 29 nested third-party gitlinks removed by A13 are also absent from final AOSP16 and Android-16 ANGLE repositories. Current dependencies are supplied by the platform checkout/build integration rather than independently initialized nested repositories.
rules.necessity: Required to keep repository initialization deterministic and avoid duplicate dependency revisions.
rules.performance: Reduces checkout and submodule initialization size; runtime graphics performance is unaffected.
rules.security: Eliminates independently pinned nested sources that could drift from the platform-reviewed dependency set.
validation_evidence: Git index checks across A13 final, AOSP16 and Android-16 found zero 160000 entries for the reviewed ANGLE paths.

rules.rationale: The subprojects/dlg gitlink removed by A13 is absent from A13 final, AOSP16 and Android-16; no stale nested checkout is required by the current Freetype build.
rules.performance: Reduces checkout metadata only; no runtime effect.
rules.security: Avoids an unused independently versioned build dependency.
validation_evidence: Git index checks report no 160000 subprojects/dlg entry in all three final trees.

rules.rationale: This is an Android 12 automerger snapshot, not a BlueStacks behavioral delta. Android 16 carries a newer 130-file upstream repository; replacing it with the A13 129-file snapshot would downgrade source and metadata.
rules.necessity: Not necessary; current upstream library content is authoritative for Android 16.
rules.performance: Avoids reverting later image-decoding and view fixes.
rules.security: Retains later upstream fixes and current platform metadata rather than an old bulk snapshot.
validation_evidence: A13 final is 0de3cb2 with 129 files; AOSP16 and Android-16 use newer c1f2ae5/24a4c6e snapshots with 130 files.

rules.rationale: A13 moved 16 then-large generated test artifacts to LFS. Android 16 retains the reviewed test artifacts and applies LFS only to the two outputs that remain large in the current upstream snapshot: large.code_coverage and large.verbose_cfg. Restoring old LFS attributes for now-small or regenerated files would add storage indirection without preserving behavior.
rules.necessity: Necessary as repository storage policy only for current large objects.
rules.performance: Keeps large clone objects out of normal Git while avoiding unnecessary LFS fetches for smaller fixtures; no guest runtime effect.
rules.security: LFS availability must be validated for tests, but these fixtures are not shipped in the guest image.
validation_evidence: Android-16 .gitattributes and git lfs ls-files agree on exactly two current files; ledger comparison finds the A13 expected fixture contents retained or superseded in the current tree.
